summary: Harold Taylor, 65, of Englewood reported missing July 26 after last being seen July 22 leaving Cold Springs Campground to hike; a second search July 27 by Gilpin County SO, Gilpin OEM, Timberline Fire and GCART located him deceased near Fairburn Mountain; GCART used horses to transport the remains down; coroner: cause consistent with acute heart failure
location: Fairburn Mountain trail, northwest of Columbine Campground, Gilpin County
responding_agency: Gilpin County Sheriff's Office; Gilpin County Office of Emergency Management; Timberline Fire Protection District; Gilpin County Animal Response Team
notes: Date recorded at body-discovery date 2021-07-27 (Mountain-Ear story, parent-opened). Mined from the Mountain-Ear 2021-window angle, run 730 chunk B.
